_comment: watch-video example config. Copy this file to .watch-video.json in your working directory, or to ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/watch-video/config.json for a user-global default, then edit the values you want to pin. JSON has no comment syntax, so every real key has a sibling '_comment_<key>' key describing it -- the '_comment_*' keys themselves are ignored by the loader. Every key is OPTIONAL: omit anything you want auto-detected or defaulted, and delete the '_comment_*' keys once you no longer need them. Environment variables (WV_*) always take priority over anything in this file. This is the SAME config file location and key namespace used by the heavier sibling package watch-video-max -- one file can configure both. See README.md for the full resolution order.
_comment_python: Path to (or bare name of) a python3 interpreter. Only actually needed for parsing .srt/.vtt transcript files and, as a last resort, running faster-whisper. If omitted, auto-detection tries python3 on PATH, then $CONDA_PREFIX/bin/python3, then common conda/venv locations, picking the first one that can 'import faster_whisper'. Falls back to a bare 'python3' if none of those succeed.
_comment_ffmpeg: ffmpeg binary. Auto-detected via 'command -v ffmpeg' if omitted.
_comment_ffprobe: ffprobe binary. Auto-detected via 'command -v ffprobe' if omitted.
_comment_ytdlp: yt-dlp invocation: either a path/name of the yt-dlp binary, or a 'python -m yt_dlp' style string. Only needed when analyzing a URL instead of a local file. Auto-detected via 'command -v yt-dlp', then '<python> -m yt_dlp' if the yt_dlp module is importable.
_comment_js_runtime: Path to a JS runtime (deno or node) that yt-dlp needs for reliable YouTube extraction. Auto-detected via 'command -v deno' then 'command -v node'. Leave empty/omitted to skip passing a --js-runtimes flag to yt-dlp entirely.
_comment_work_dir: Scratch directory for extracted frames and (last-resort) audio. Needs a few GB of free space depending on configured fps. Defaults to ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/watch-video.
_comment_output_dir: Directory where finished reports (knowledge.md, report.html, transcript.txt) are written. Defaults to $HOME/watch-video/reports.
_comment_whisper_model: faster-whisper model name to load if Tier D (last resort) is reached. Defaults to large-v3; distil-large-v3 is used automatically for clean English narration regardless of this setting, this key only controls the escalation tier (non-English or hard audio).
_comment_whisper_device: 'cuda' or 'cpu'. Leave as 'auto' (or omit) to auto-detect from ctranslate2's reported CUDA device count. Only relevant if Tier D is reached.
_comment_whisper_compute: ctranslate2 compute type, e.g. 'float16' or 'int8'. Leave as 'auto' (or omit) to auto-select: float16 when whisper_device resolves to cuda, int8 when it resolves to cpu. Only relevant if Tier D is reached.
_comment_knowledge_fps: Frame extraction rate (frames per second). Default is 1.
